opening.argument: The presentation is primarily an instructional explanation of Amazon affiliate marketing and the Amazon Associate Program. Viewers are told to search for the program and sign up, then market affiliate links so that purchases generate commissions in their accounts. The speaker describes the method as making money without investment and calls it completely legal. Although the title and earnings discussion introduce promotional income claims, the speaker expressly rejects the expectation of becoming a millionaire overnight. The material therefore explains a participation process with unverified earnings examples, while showing no payment demand or credential-harvesting screen; any consultation outcomes likewise remain unverified.
